title: The Sovereign Power & Security Stack: budget, mirror, and protect

intro.headline: Zero-fee budgeting, seamless phone control, and offline 2FA security.
intro.subhead: Actual Budget, Scrcpy, and Aegis replace YNAB, Vysor, and Google Authenticator with lightweight, zero-tracking tools.

outro.headline: Take back control of your devices and money.
outro.subhead: No $100/yr budgeting subscriptions, no cloud lock-in for your 2FA keys, and instant phone mirroring over standard USB.
